description: 40 synthetic job postings with hand-written labels for JD extraction. Every company, person and link is made up. 'today' fixes the date used to resolve deadlines. A list of strings means any of them is accepted (compared case- and punctuation-insensitively). salary null means all salary numbers must be null.

Fernway Labs is hiring a Generative AI Intern (6 months) to join our applied research team in Bengaluru. Hybrid: 3 days a week in office.

What you'll do: build retrieval-augmented generation prototypes, evaluate LLM outputs, and ship internal tools.

Must have:
- Strong Python and good knowledge of SQL
- Experience with at least one LLM API (OpenAI, Gemini or Claude)
Good to have: LangChain or LlamaIndex, Docker.

Stipend: ₹50,000 per month. Apply by 15 Nov via https://example.com/fernway/careers/genai-intern

Software Development Engineer I – Payments
Cobalt Fintech | Mumbai (Work from office, 5 days)

About us: Cobalt Fintech processes over 2 million UPI transactions a day for small merchants across India.

You will design and build services in Java and Spring Boot, own on-call for your services, and work closely with product.

Requirements
• B.Tech/B.E. in CS or related field (2025/2026 graduates)
• Solid data structures and algorithms
• Java or Kotlin
• Understanding of REST APIs and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
Preferred: Kafka, Redis

CTC: ₹14–18 LPA. Applications close on 30/11/2026.

We're Tidewater Games, an indie studio making cozy multiplayer games. We're looking for a Gameplay Programmer on a 6-month contract, fully remote (any timezone overlapping 4 hours with UTC+1).

You'll prototype mechanics in Unity (C#), fix bugs, and work with our two designers.

You have: shipped at least one game (jam games count), strong C#, comfortable with Git.
Bonus: Mirror or Netcode for GameObjects experience, shaders.

Pay: $40/hour, ~30 hours a week. Send your portfolio to jobs@tidewater.example — we review applications on a rolling basis.

Hiring: Data Analyst Intern | Harbor Health Tech | Hyderabad

Duration: 3 months (Jan–Mar 2027), full-time, on-site at our Gachibowli office.
Stipend: 20k per month

Responsibilities
- Clean and analyse hospital operations data
- Build dashboards in Power BI
- Present weekly insights to the operations lead

Who can apply
- Students in their final or pre-final year
- Excel and SQL are a must
- Python (pandas) is a plus

Last date to apply: 10th December

Our client, a fast-growing Series B fintech in Gurugram, is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Go).

— 5+ years building distributed systems
— Go in production, gRPC, PostgreSQL
— Experience with event-driven architecture (Kafka/NATS)

Compensation: 35-45 LPA + ESOPs. Hybrid (2 days in office).

Interested? Reply with your CV. TalentBridge Recruiters Pvt Ltd.

Paperkite is a two-person design studio. We need a freelance Frontend Developer to turn our Figma designs for a bakery chain's website into a fast static site (Astro or Next.js, your choice).

Scope: 6 pages, a menu page fed from a Google Sheet, contact form. Must be responsive and score 90+ on Lighthouse.

Budget: €1,500 for the whole project. Remote. Start next week.

Show us 2–3 sites you built: https://example.com/paperkite/freelance-frontend

Machine Learning Engineer

Location: London, UK (hybrid, 2 days/week in our Shoreditch office)
Salary: £55,000 – £70,000 per annum

Brightloom builds forecasting tools for grocery retailers. As an ML Engineer you will train and deploy demand forecasting models, own the feature pipeline and monitor models in production.

You'll need:
• Python, PyTorch or scikit-learn
• Experience deploying models (Docker, a cloud provider)
• Solid statistics
Nice to have: time-series experience, dbt, Airflow.

Closing date: 21 November 2026.

Kestrel Data — Data Engineering Internship (Summer 2027)

Location: Chennai
Duration: 8–10 weeks starting May 2027
Stipend: Competitive

You'll help build batch pipelines with Apache Spark and Airflow on AWS, write data quality checks and document datasets.

Required: Python, SQL, basic Linux. Preferred: Spark, any cloud certification.

Apply at https://example.com/kestrel/internships before 31 Jan 2027.

URGENT HIRING!!! Full Stack Developer (MERN) - Noida - Immediate joiners preferred

Orbitline Software Solutions
Exp: 1-3 yrs
Salary: 6 to 9 LPA

Skills: React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, REST APIs, Git. Knowledge of AWS is an added advantage.

Work from office, Mon-Fri. Walk-in interviews every Saturday 10am-1pm at Sector 62.

Lumen Robotics | Embedded Software Intern

Pune · On-site · 6 months · Starts January 2027

Work on firmware for our warehouse robots: motor control, sensor drivers and testing on real hardware.

Must: C/C++, microcontrollers (STM32 or similar), reading datasheets.
Good to have: ROS 2, RTOS experience.

Stipend ₹35,000/month + housing support. Deadline: December 1.

About the role
Quillstack is looking for a Backend Developer Intern to work on our document collaboration API. You'll write Node.js (TypeScript) services, add tests and help with migrations to PostgreSQL.

What we're looking for
- Comfortable with JavaScript/TypeScript
- Understands HTTP, REST and SQL basics
- Curious, writes clear PR descriptions

Perks: ₹30k monthly stipend, MacBook, flexible hours.
Where: Gurugram office (we're in-office 4 days a week)
When: 6 months, starting ASAP

Northwind Analytics – AI Engineer Intern (LLM Applications)

Hybrid · Bengaluru

Northwind helps retailers understand their shoppers. Our new GenAI team builds assistants for store managers.

You will:
1. Build RAG pipelines over product catalogues
2. Write evaluation sets and measure answer quality
3. Ship features behind our FastAPI backend

Requirements: Python, FastAPI or Flask, prompt engineering, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone or similar).
Nice: experience with LangGraph or agents, a public GitHub project with LLMs.

Stipend: INR 45,000 per month. Applications are open until 20 November 2026.

Position: DevOps Engineer
Company: Skyward Logistics
Location: Remote (India)
Type: Full-time

We run 40 microservices on Kubernetes (EKS). Help us improve CI/CD, observability and cost.

Required: 2+ years with Kubernetes and Terraform, AWS, a scripting language (Bash/Python). On-call rotation 1 week in 6.
Preferred: ArgoCD, Prometheus/Grafana.

Salary range: INR 20,00,000 – 28,00,000 per year.

Summer Research Intern — Computer Vision
Astera Vision, Zurich, Switzerland

Join our perception team for 12 weeks (June–August 2027) to research self-supervised learning for industrial inspection.

You are pursuing a Master's or PhD in CS/EE, have published or are preparing a paper, and are strong in PyTorch. Experience with vision transformers is a plus.

Compensation: CHF 4,500 per month. Relocation support provided.
Apply by January 15, 2027 at https://example.com/astera/research-intern-cv

Bluepeak AI is hiring a Machine Learning Intern (remote, 6 months).
Work on fine-tuning small language models for customer-support classification.
Must: Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, basic NLP. Nice: Hugging Face Transformers.
Stipend: ₹40,000/month. Apply before 5 December 2026.

Junior QA Automation Engineer — Veridian Health, Kochi

We build telemedicine apps used by 300 clinics. You'll write and maintain automated tests (Selenium/Playwright with Java or TypeScript), test REST APIs with Postman and report bugs in Jira.

0–2 years of experience. ISTQB certification is a plus.

Salary: ₹4.5–6 LPA. Onsite. Interviews end 18 Nov.

Product Design Intern

Marigold Commerce (D2C skincare) · Delhi · Hybrid

Help redesign our checkout and build a component library in Figma. You'll run usability tests with real customers every two weeks.

Portfolio required. Familiarity with Figma auto-layout and basic HTML/CSS is a plus.

4 months, ₹25,000 stipend per month. Apply by 2 Dec.

Site Reliability Engineer II

At Halcyon Cloud, SREs own reliability for our managed database platform (Postgres and Redis) serving 5,000 customers.

What you'll bring
- 3+ years in SRE/infra roles
- Linux internals, networking, Kubernetes
- Go or Python for automation
- Incident response and postmortems

US-based remote role. Base pay range: $150,000 - $185,000 USD. We accept applications until the position is filled.

Trainee Software Engineer (Graduate Programme 2027)
Ironclad Systems — Chennai / Coimbatore

Our 12-month graduate programme rotates you across three teams (backend, data, platform) with a mentor.

Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech 2027 batch (CS/IT/ECE), no active backlogs, 7.0 CGPA or above.
Test topics: aptitude, coding (any language), SQL.

Stipend during training ₹25,000/month; ₹6.5 LPA on confirmation.
Registration closes 12/12/2026.

Hi! I'm Ananya from Saffron Bytes 👋
We're a 12-person startup building an AI tutor for school students, and we need a React Native Developer (freelance, ~3 months) to build our Android + iOS app.

You'll get designs in Figma and a working backend (Firebase). Need someone who has published at least one app on the Play Store.

Budget is ₹1.2 lakh for the project, paid in 3 milestones. Fully remote.
DM me or fill https://example.com/saffron/rn-freelance by this Friday (Oct 30)!

Associate Consultant – Data & AI

Greyfield Consulting · Bengaluru, Hyderabad or Pune · Hybrid

Work with enterprise clients to build analytics and machine learning solutions on Azure. Expect client travel up to 30%.

You bring: 1–2 years in data science or analytics, Python and SQL, clear communication. Azure or Databricks certification preferred.

We offer a competitive salary and a learning budget.

Cybersecurity Intern (Blue Team)
SentinelPeak Security | New Delhi | 6 months, onsite

Monitor alerts in our SOC, write detection rules (Sigma/KQL) and help with phishing simulations.

Requirements: networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS), Linux, basic scripting in Python or PowerShell. CEH/Security+ or CTF experience is a bonus.

Stipend: ₹18,000 per month.
The deadline to apply is 25th October 2026.

Technical Writer (contract, 4 months)

Cirrus API Co. needs a technical writer to rewrite our developer docs: quickstarts, API reference clean-up and three tutorials.

You can read code (JavaScript or Python), have written developer docs before, and know Markdown and Git.

Rate: USD 35–45 per hour depending on experience. Remote, async.
Please apply by November 7.

Join Ember Mobility as an Android Developer!

Where: Bengaluru (Koramangala) — in office Tuesday to Thursday
Experience: 2–4 years
Compensation: 12-16 LPA

You'll build features for our EV charging app used by 400k drivers: maps, payments and offline mode.

Must: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Coroutines. Good to have: Google Maps SDK, experience with BLE.

Apply: https://example.com/ember/android — closes 28 Nov 2026

Cloud Support Associate
Nimbus Hosting, Indore (on-site, rotational shifts)

Help customers with Linux servers, DNS and email issues over chat and tickets.
You need: Linux basics, networking basics, good written English. Freshers welcome.
Salary: 3.6 LPA + shift allowance.

Backend Engineer (Python) — Remote, Europe

Latticeworks GmbH builds scheduling software for hospitals across Germany and Austria.

Stack: Python 3.12, Django, PostgreSQL, Celery, deployed on Kubernetes. You'll own features end to end.

You have 3+ years with Django or FastAPI and write well-tested code. German is a plus, not required.

Salary: €65,000–€80,000 per year. Remote within EU timezones.

Teaching Assistant – Data Science Bootcamp (Part-time, Contract)
CodeHarbor Academy | Remote

Support learners during live sessions (Mon/Wed/Fri 7–10pm IST), review assignments and hold doubt-clearing calls.

You know Python, pandas, basic ML (scikit-learn) and enjoy explaining things.

Pay: ₹600 per hour. Contract for the 16-week cohort starting 1 December.

Graduate Software Engineer — Singapore

Kaya Payments is hiring 2026/2027 graduates for our Singapore engineering hub. On-site.

You'll join a squad building cross-border payment rails in Java/Kotlin and TypeScript.

Requirements: degree in CS or related, strong problem-solving, at least one internship or substantial project. Must be eligible to work in Singapore or need an Employment Pass (we sponsor).

Salary: SGD 5,500–6,500 monthly. Applications close Dec 15.

Hiring for a well-known product company (name disclosed after the first round)
Role: Frontend Engineer (React)
Location: Hyderabad, hybrid
CTC up to 22 LPA based on interview
Skills: React, TypeScript, Redux/Zustand, testing with Jest/RTL, performance optimisation.
— posted by HireLoop Staffing

Research Assistant (NLP) — 6-month project
Indic Language Lab, IIT-style research centre at Varanasi

Work on speech-to-text for low-resource Indian languages: data collection, training Whisper-style models and evaluation.

Eligibility: B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc. with Python and deep learning experience. Knowledge of any Indian language besides Hindi and English is a plus.

Consolidated pay: ₹42,000 per month. On campus.
Send CV by 9 November 2026 to the PI.

Solutions Engineer, India
Polaris Observability · Bengaluru · Hybrid

Partner with our sales team on technical discovery, demos and proof-of-concepts for observability (logs, metrics, traces).

4+ years in a technical customer-facing role or as a software/SRE engineer. Comfortable with Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry and at least one scripting language.

OTE: ₹45–55 LPA (70/30 split).
We review applications weekly.

We are looking for a Python Developer Intern!

Company: Mosaic Learning
Mode: Work from home
Duration: 2 months
Stipend: ₹10,000 total

Tasks: write scripts to clean quiz data, build small Flask APIs, help migrate Google Sheets to Postgres.
Required: Python, basic Flask, Git. You should be available 4 hours a day.

Apply before 3rd November.

Staff Engineer, Search Infrastructure — Toronto, Canada (Hybrid)

Otterly Docs is building the fastest search across company knowledge. Lead the design of our indexing and retrieval systems (Elasticsearch today, moving to a hybrid vector + keyword stack).

8+ years of backend experience, deep experience with search or databases, Java/Go/Rust. Experience with embeddings and ANN indexes is a strong plus.

CAD $210,000–$250,000 base + equity.

Database Administrator (PostgreSQL)

Riverbend Bank — Ahmedabad (GIFT City), on-site

Marketing Analytics Intern at Lotus Travel

You: a student who loves numbers; SQL and spreadsheets required, Python is a bonus.

₹12k/month. Hybrid (2 days in Jaipur office). Starting 2 January 2027, apply by 20 December.

Robotics Software Engineer
Veloce Autonomy (Munich, Germany) — on-site

Develop motion planning for autonomous forklifts in C++17 and ROS 2. Work with perception and controls teams to test on our track.

MSc in Robotics/CS or equivalent experience, strong C++, Linux. Nice to have: experience with Nav2, MPC, simulation in Gazebo or Isaac Sim.

Salary €70k–€85k. Visa sponsorship available. Apply at https://example.com/veloce/jobs/rse by 6 Jan 2027.
